subject: Chemistry
title: Amines and Diazonium Salts
summary: Amines ammonia ke derivatives hain: primary (RNH₂), secondary (R₂NH) aur tertiary (R₃N) — inki nomenclature aur classification isi par. Nitrogen ka lone pair inhe bases (basic nature) aur nucleophiles banata hai; nitrogen sp³ aur molecule pyramidal.

Aliphatic amines ammonia se strong bases hain (alkyl groups ka +I effect); aniline jaise aromatic amines bahut kamzor (lone pair ring mein delocalised). Paani mein order +I effect, solvation aur steric hindrance milkar tay karte hain.
Primary, secondary aur tertiary amines ko Hinsberg test, carbylamine test (sirf primary) aur nitrous acid ke saath reactions se alag karte hain.
0–5 °C par aniline NaNO₂/HCl se benzenediazonium chloride banata hai, ek bahut kaam ka intermediate: Sandmeyer, Gattermann, coupling (azo dyes) aur –OH, –I, –F, –H se replacement.

formulas.name: Reduction of nitro compounds
formulas.note: Fe/HCl pasand kiya jaata hai: bana FeCl₂ hydrolyse hokar HCl deta hai, isliye thoda hi acid chahiye — yaad rakho.

formulas.name: Gabriel phthalimide synthesis
formulas.formula: phthalimide + KOH → potassium phthalimide;  + RX → N-alkylphthalimide;  hydrolysis → RNH₂
formulas.mistake: Aromatic amines nahi ban sakte (aryl halides phthalimide anion ke saath SN nahi karte) — galat mat lo.

formulas.name: Hoffmann bromamide degradation
formulas.when: Amide se ek carbon kam wala amine.

formulas.name: Reduction of nitriles and amides
formulas.formula: RCN + LiAlH₄ (or H₂/Ni) → RCH₂NH₂ (one carbon more);  RCONH₂ + LiAlH₄ → RCH₂NH₂

formulas.name: Ammonolysis of alkyl halides
formulas.formula: RX + NH₃ → RNH₂ → R₂NH → R₃N → R₄N⁺X⁻
formulas.mistake: Mixture banta hai; NH₃ ki bahut zyada maatra primary amine ko badhaati hai — dhyan rakho.

formulas.name: Basicity in water (methyl)
formulas.mistake: Gas phase mein order 3° > 2° > 1° > NH₃; paani mein solvation ise badal deta hai — dono mix mat karo.

formulas.name: Basicity of anilines
formulas.formula: p-toluidine > aniline > p-nitroaniline;  pKb larger = weaker base
formulas.mistake: Electron-donating groups basicity badhaate hain; −R/−I groups ghataate hain — ulta mat lo.

formulas.name: Hinsberg test
formulas.formula: C₆H₅SO₂Cl:  1° → sulphonamide soluble in KOH;  2° → sulphonamide insoluble in KOH;  3° → no reaction

formulas.name: Reaction with nitrous acid
formulas.formula: aliphatic 1° amine + HNO₂ → alcohol + N₂↑;  aniline + NaNO₂/HCl (273–278 K) → C₆H₅N₂⁺Cl⁻

formulas.name: Diazonium replacements
formulas.formula: CuCl/HCl → ArCl;  CuBr/HBr → ArBr;  CuCN/KCN → ArCN (Sandmeyer);  Cu/HX → ArX (Gattermann);  KI → ArI;  HBF₄, heat → ArF;  H₃PO₂ or ethanol → ArH;  warm water → ArOH

formulas.name: Coupling reaction
formulas.mistake: Yahan N≡N group bacha rehta hai — replacement reactions ke ulta, confuse mat karo.

examples.title: Hoffmann product
examples.problem: Propanamide ko Br₂ aur NaOH ke saath. Product?
examples.solution: Ethanamine, CH₃CH₂NH₂ — amide (CH₃CH₂CONH₂) se ek carbon kam.

examples.title: 1°, 2°, 3° alag karo
examples.problem: Ethylamine, diethylamine aur triethylamine ko kaise alag karoge?
examples.solution: Hinsberg reagent: ethylamine KOH mein ghulne wala sulphonamide; diethylamine na ghulne wala; triethylamine react nahi karta. Sirf ethylamine carbylamine (badboo) test deta hai.

examples.title: Aniline kamzor base kyun?
examples.problem: Aniline methylamine se kamzor kyun hai?
examples.solution: Aniline mein N ka lone pair benzene ring mein delocalised hai (resonance), isliye H⁺ ke liye kam available. Methylamine mein CH₃ ka +I effect lone pair ko zyada available banata hai.

examples.title: Aniline ka bromination
examples.problem: Aniline + bromine water? Sirf p-bromoaniline kaise banaoge?
examples.solution: Bromine water 2,4,6-tribromoaniline (safed ppt) deta hai kyunki –NH₂ ring ko bahut activate karta hai. –NH₂ ko acetylation se bachao (acetanilide), brominate karo (p-product), phir hydrolyse karo.

examples.title: Aniline ka nitration
examples.problem: Seedhe nitration mein bahut saara m-nitroaniline kyun banta hai?
examples.solution: Strong acidic medium mein aniline protonate hokar anilinium ion (–NH₃⁺) banta hai jo meta-directing hai. Lagbhag 47% meta product, para aur thoda ortho ke saath, plus oxidation products.

examples.title: Diazonium route
examples.solution: Aniline + NaNO₂/HCl 0–5 °C par → benzenediazonium chloride; phir CuCN/KCN (Sandmeyer) → C₆H₅CN.

topics.title: Structure and nomenclature
topics.explain: Amines mein nitrogen sp³ aur lone pair ke saath; C–N–C angle ~108°. Common names: methylamine, aniline (benzenamine), N,N-dimethylaniline. IUPAC: alkanamine (ethanamine), N-methylethanamine.

topics.title: Physical properties
topics.explain: Chhote aliphatic amines machhli jaisi gandh wali gases. Primary aur secondary amines intermolecular hydrogen bonds banate hain; isomeric amines ke boiling points: 1° > 2° > 3°. Tertiary amines mein N–H nahi, isliye aapas mein H-bond nahi.

topics.title: Acylation
topics.explain: Primary aur secondary amines acid chlorides ya anhydrides ke saath (nucleophilic substitution) amides banate hain; pyridine HCl hataata hai. Benzoylation benzoyl chloride se. Acetylation –NH₂ ka activating effect kam karta hai.

topics.title: Electrophilic substitution of aniline
topics.explain: –NH₂ strongly activating aur o/p-directing. Sulphonation se sulphanilic acid jo zwitterion ki tarah rehta hai. Aniline Friedel–Crafts nahi karta: AlCl₃ (Lewis acid) ke saath salt banata hai jo ring ko deactivate karta hai.

topics.title: Diazonium salts
topics.explain: ArN₂⁺X⁻; sirf 273–278 K par stable kyunki positive charge benzene ring par delocalised (aliphatic diazonium salts unstable). Solution mein turant use hote hain aur aromatic compounds aur dyes banane mein bahut important.

topics.title: Importance in daily life
topics.explain: Amines proteins, vitamins, alkaloids aur hormones mein milte hain; synthetic examples mein drugs aur dyes. Quaternary ammonium salts detergents ki tarah use hote hain.

ratta: Hinsberg: 1° soluble in KOH, 2° insoluble, 3° no reaction.
Sandmeyer CuX;  Gattermann Cu/HX;  H₃PO₂ → ArH.
Aniline: no Friedel–Crafts; nitration gives ~47% meta.
